# Ghosxt

> Ghosxt provides managed IT services and cybersecurity for small businesses on
> California's Central Coast and beyond. The company is run by a sole engineer with DoD
> infrastructure experience and delivers managed detection and response with a 24/7 SOC
> at small-business pricing. Based in Salinas, CA, Ghosxt serves the
> Monterey Bay, Salinas Valley, San Benito County, and Silicon Valley.

Key facts:
- Business: Ghosxt (managed IT services provider / MSP)
- Owner and sole engineer: Ulises Paiz, based in Salinas, CA
- Location: Salinas, California, USA (serves the surrounding region)
- Phone: +1 (831) 204-0501
- Email: sales@ghosxt.com
- Differentiator: run by a DoD-cleared engineer with prior DoD and federal contractor
  infrastructure experience; managed detection and response with a 24/7 SOC without an
  enterprise price tag
- Credentials: M.S. Cybersecurity and Information Assurance (WGU, 2026); Microsoft AZ-104;
  CompTIA SecurityX (CAS-005), CySA+, Security+, Network+, Cloud+, Project+; ITIL 4
  Foundation; Linux Essentials
- SAM.gov registered; carries cyber liability, general liability, and professional
  liability insurance
- Contracted deliverables: 4-hour notification on actual or reasonably suspected critical
  incidents; annual independent risk assessment arranged through a third-party assessor;
  SOC 2 documentation for every platform in the stack provided during onboarding; written
  policy suite (WISP, incident response, BC/DR, access control and acceptable use,
  retention and destruction, AI acceptable use)
- Pricing (published): Core Managed IT $125/user/mo, Secure Growth $175/user/mo,
  Compliance & Continuity $250/user/mo; flat-rate Tiny Team Managed Security
  $600/mo for teams of 1–4 users; onboarding $1,000 for Tiny Team, $1,500 for 5 to 15
  users on the Microsoft 365 default scope (Google Workspace and Apple fleet onboarding
  scoped and quoted separately)
- Free 30-minute IT assessment with no obligation

## Services
- [Managed IT Services](https://ghosxt.com/managed-it-services): managed detection and response with a 24/7 SOC, patching, Microsoft 365 hardening, and cloud backup for small business.
- [IT Help Desk & Support](https://ghosxt.com/help-desk-it-support): you talk directly to the owner, Ulises Paiz, for end-user support, remote and on-site across the Central Coast. Support runs 8am to 6pm Pacific, Monday through Friday.
- [IT Consulting & vCIO](https://ghosxt.com/it-consulting-vcio): strategic IT roadmap, budget, security and compliance strategy, and vendor-neutral vCIO guidance.
- [Cybersecurity](https://ghosxt.com/cybersecurity): managed detection and response with a 24/7 SOC, MFA, cloud backup, and security awareness training.
- [Cloud Services & Microsoft 365](https://ghosxt.com/cloud-services): Microsoft 365 hardening with Intune, Defender for Business, and Conditional Access, plus Google Workspace as identity provider with phishing-resistant MFA.
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://ghosxt.com/backup-disaster-recovery): cloud backup for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
- [Network Design & Architecture](https://ghosxt.com/network-design): network design and deployment for small business offices: VLAN segmentation, firewalls, business wireless, and written documentation.
- [Website Development](https://ghosxt.com/website-development): custom small-business websites and e-commerce that load fast and convert. City pages: [Salinas](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-salinas), [Monterey](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-monterey), [Santa Cruz](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-santa-cruz), [Watsonville](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-watsonville), [San Jose](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-san-jose), [Carmel](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-carmel), [Gilroy](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-gilroy), [Hollister](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-hollister), [Marina](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-marina), [Pacific Grove](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-pacific-grove), and [Seaside](https://ghosxt.com/web-design-seaside).
- [C-TPAT Compliance](https://ghosxt.com/ctpat): IT controls and documentation for supply-chain security certification.
- [CMMC & NIST 800-171](https://ghosxt.com/cmmc-compliance): Microsoft 365 GCC High setup and hardening for defense contractors; the compliance assessment is arranged through a third-party assessor. From an engineer with DoD infrastructure experience.
- [HIPAA IT Compliance](https://ghosxt.com/hipaa-it-compliance): HIPAA technical safeguards for medical practices, covering security risk analysis, access controls, encryption, BAAs, and backup.
- [PCI DSS Compliance](https://ghosxt.com/pci-compliance): practical PCI compliance for retail, restaurants, and hospitality, covering segmentation, secure POS, and SAQ guidance.
- [Cyber Insurance Compliance](https://ghosxt.com/cyber-insurance-compliance): cyber insurance readiness and questionnaire help, covering MFA, MDR, cloud backup, and the evidence carriers require at underwriting and claim time.
- [Co-Managed IT](https://ghosxt.com/co-managed-it): augments an existing in-house IT team with managed detection and response with a 24/7 SOC and cybersecurity depth, without replacing anyone.
- [Ransomware Recovery & Emergency IT](https://ghosxt.com/ransomware-recovery): for businesses that are down or under active attack: the 4-hour notification commitment on actual or reasonably suspected critical incidents, and restoration from cloud backup for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Emergency line (831) 204-0501.
- [Break-Fix vs. Managed IT](https://ghosxt.com/break-fix-vs-managed-it): an honest comparison of the two IT support models on cost, downtime, and security.
- [Pricing](https://ghosxt.com/pricing): transparent, published managed IT service plans.
- [What managed IT costs in Monterey County](https://ghosxt.com/managed-it-cost-monterey-county): published prices ($125 to $250 per user per month, or $600 flat for 1 to 4 users), how MSPs price, and three worked examples with the arithmetic shown.

## Industries served
- [Agriculture & Agribusiness IT](https://ghosxt.com/agriculture-it-services): Salinas Valley growers, food processing, and ag-tech.
- [Trucking & Logistics IT](https://ghosxt.com/trucking-it-services): C-TPAT, ELD, fleet, and dispatch systems.
- [Manufacturing IT](https://ghosxt.com/manufacturing-it-services): OT/IT, ERP, and CMMC.
- [Healthcare & Medical IT](https://ghosxt.com/healthcare-it-services): HIPAA, EHR, and PHI protection.
- [Hospitality IT](https://ghosxt.com/hospitality-it-services): restaurants, hotels, and wineries.
- [Professional Services IT](https://ghosxt.com/professional-services-it): law firms, CPAs, and small offices.
- [Property Management IT](https://ghosxt.com/property-management-it-services): Yardi and AppFolio environments.
- [Engineering & A/E IT](https://ghosxt.com/engineering-it-services): CAD, BIM, and ITAR.
- [IT support for nonprofits on Google Workspace](https://ghosxt.com/it-support-nonprofits-google-workspace): Google Workspace admin and backup, contractors covered per identity, and Mac onboarding through Apple Business Manager.
- [Managed IT for remote, Mac-first teams](https://ghosxt.com/it-support-remote-mac-teams): zero-touch Apple Business Manager enrollment, remote lock and erase, and sign-in monitoring across countries.
